blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — Police arrested a 55-year-old man and seized 5.28 grams of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) with an estimated street value of P35,904 during an anti-illegal drug operation in Linapacan, Palawan, on Saturday, Sept. 26.
